name: Smart Lighting Control for Hue & Govee
description:
Control Philips Hue and Govee lighting from CORSAIR XENEON Edge without Home Assistant. Use touch controls for power, brightness, RGB color, color temperature, favorites, Hue rooms/zones, and scenes when supported. Live state keeps the panel synced instead of acting like blind shortcuts.

Philips Hue pairs directly with your local Hue Bridge after you press its physical link button. Govee uses LAN Control first on compatible devices; optionally add your own Govee Developer API key for cloud-only devices, capabilities, and scenes.

Requires Windows and the free PackRat Lighting Companion: https://packrat-site.pages.dev/downloads/smart-lighting. The companion binds only to localhost and stores Hue/Govee credentials in Windows Credential Manager. No PackRat cloud or PackRat account is required.

Hue-only and Govee-only setups are supported. Unsupported controls are hidden automatically.

Independent third-party PackRat product. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Signify, Philips Hue, or Govee. Part of the PackRat Ecosystem.
release_notes: Direct Philips Hue Bridge pairing and local light, room/zone, scene, brightness, color and color-temperature control.
Local-first Govee LAN discovery/control with optional Govee Developer API support for cloud-only capabilities and scenes.
Favorites, one-touch scenes, live capability-aware state, and touch-first color/brightness controls.
Eight tuned XENEON Edge layouts plus a localhost-only PackRat Lighting Companion with no PackRat cloud.
